target.description: Id of exactly one {node} (`<{group}>/<{node}>`); {group} ids are rejected

action.description: `module`: the one module `moduleId` of the diagram `diagram`, its secrets masked; `libraries`: a page of the uploaded library files

diagram.description: The diagram (workflow) that holds the module; required for and only allowed with `module`

moduleId.description: The numeric id of the module in its diagram; required for and only allowed with `module`

libraryType.description: Only the libraries of this type; without it both types are listed, drivers first; only with `libraries`

offset.description: Position of the first library of the page, e.g. the nextOffset of the last page; only with `libraries`

limit.description: Number of libraries of one page; only with `libraries`
